title: Mixed Event — Let SEKAI Hear Your Song! — Episode6 Where Feelings Meet

meta.Event Outline: The VIRTUAL SINGERS of each SEKAI see how everyone is progressing toward their goals. They are excitedly preparing ways to demonstrate their support for everyone, when something extraordinary happens.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Where are we...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: This could be another SEKAI born out of someone's feelings.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Which means that thing had to be a fragment of a feeling! But what feelings was this SEKAI born from?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I'm not sure, but look...
I think I see each of the others' SEKAI among all these floating fragments.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Whoa, you're right...!
Does this mean we can peer into a bunch of different SEKAI from this SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Possibly.
For now, let's try to learn more about where we are.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Right.
It looks extremely expansive, so why don't we split up to cover more ground...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Okay!
See you guys later!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: This SEKAI is so strange...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Not only is our SEKAI visible from inside a fragment, but I can see all these other ones as well.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I thought this might be another person's SEKAI at first... But I guess it's not.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Why do you say that?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I mean, who would know this many SEKAI?
Huh? That looks like...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, I knew it!
Hi, me!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, uhh...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
This is so amazing!
I wasn't sure if this was actually possible!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I've been watching you this whole time!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You've been watching me...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! The way you express yourself through singing is so great! And you have such a beautiful voice!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: No, I'm really not that great a...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Don't say that! I know you're doing your best for everyone, so I'm gonna keep rooting for you!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, since we're here together like this, let's sing!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I bet we'd sound amazing if we sang together right now!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Rin certainly seems excited.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thank you for being such a strong source of support for the others.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: All we can do is watch over them, but I can see that they're in good hands!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I haven't really done anything for them...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Rin and the others are the ones who help them.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh? I think you've done plenty for them already.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I have...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes! Based on what I've seen watching you all this time, it's obvious to me that they need you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You don't always have to put what you feel into words. They feel better just knowing that you're there for them.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, again, thank you!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
M-Me?!
But how...?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm not sure either. I just ended up in this SEKAI for some reason...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh, that also happened to me.
Still... Hmm...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
No, it's just... I look...
I mean, you look so cool!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm still not sure how I got here, but it's really great to meet you!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Ahaha...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I feel the same way. It's nice to meet you.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: This gives me an opportunity to thank you for doing what you can for the others.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Your cheerful personality and the way you freely express yourself through words and music have been an enormous source of support for them.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I've been wanting to meet you for the longest time! You're such a great guitarist, you're mature and you're so cool!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Cool? Me...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! You were just having guitar practice, right? It's super cool how you're trying to pull everyone forward through your singing and playing!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Y-You think so...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I know so! Which is why I also need to do better!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So, let's both do our best!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, let's...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's so wonderful how you're able to spread so much hope as an idol.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And you shine so brightly each time you take the stage. I get a huge boost of encouragement whenever I see you perform...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm a source of encouragement for you?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you so much...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'll put your words to good use by shining even brighter moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Wow...!
Are you me?! Is this really happening?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, I'm really here!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I've been watching what you've been doing for so long!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The shows you put on are always so fun and exciting. It's wonderful how they put smiles on everyone's faces.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You've seen my shows?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I have! They always fill me with so much hope and joy!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Which is also why I know that you've been doing your best to support the others.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Even if they get stuck or run into a problem that they don't know how to solve in the future...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I'm sure they'll be fine!
Because I know you'll be there to help them!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, keep up the good work!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Now, can you tell me more about yourself?! I wanna learn more about this me I don't know☆

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. I see. Then...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh...
I think this SEKAI is about to disappear.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What?! But I wanna keep chatting...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Me too. After finally getting a chance to meet you...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Wait, before we have to go!
There's something I need to ask you!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ask me?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah, um!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: When I was practicing for my next show just now, I heard someone say, “You can do it!”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Was that...?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes! That was me!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I was cheering you all on so that you can keep doing your best for the others!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thanks!
